description: Reports the payment state of an order created by formation.checkout: awaiting, processing (the payment method settles later, or Corpus is recording it), paid, expired, failed, underpaid, held (staff review, including a payment hold or dispute) or refunded (in full; formation.status separately reports filing progress) — plus which rail it is on and whether the founder has confirmed by email (required within 48 hours of payment; it reads expired once that window closes unconfirmed, and the order is then listed for a refund). Free; does not consume credits.
name: formation.payment_status

isError.description: True when the tool could not complete successfully.

text.description: Human-readable tool result (also mirrored in content[].text).

title: Check a formation order's payment
